kcc_query_text_example: Minority large coconut grower with 13.0 acres holding in Puttur taluk, Dakshina Kannada; acquired land title via registered statutory succession following mother's demise in April 2022 (Death Cert DC/DK/2022/6104 and Bhoomi mutation Form 16 MR No. 2022-T771 verified); seeking 50% capital subsidy under MIDH for shaded coastal nursery / shade-net protected cultivation; verifying PM-KISAN succession status and solar pump replacement for diesel pump.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: Perennial large-diameter open well equipped with 5 HP diesel pump set; off-grid water source

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: Title acquired via registered inheritance succession following demise of mother in April 2022; Death Cert No. DC/DK/2022/6104, Legal Heir Certificate LHC/DK/2022/339, and Bhoomi mutation Form 16 MR No. 2022-T771 (22.06.2022) verified

statutory_succession_details.statutory_distinction: Ownership transferred through inheritance resulting from demise of parent (§5.2 and §5.3.3(i)); strictly distinct from post-cutoff sale, partition, or gift deeds which are excluded under §5.3.3(ii).
statutory_succession_details.engine_input_interpretation: land_ownership_cutoff_pre_feb_2019 = True correctly represents statutory compliance under the §§5.2–5.3.3(i) inheritance exception, passing the PMKISAN_CUTOFF_DATE_VERIFIED rule.

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: Directorate of Horticulture Karnataka & MIDH Cell: Commercial coconut and cocoa nurseries in Puttur taluk adopting shade-net protected cultivation structures for raising quality planting material, combined with off-grid open well solar pumping.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: Synthetic benchmark query formulation inspired by Kisan Call Centre (KCC) Karnataka advisory themes and MIDH horticulture queries: Large horticulture plantation owners with inherited titles inquiring about MIDH nursery subsidies, solar water pumping, and PM-KISAN succession registration.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Design v1.0.4 Section 3.3.1 (PM-KISAN Statutory Succession vs Partition Deed Safeguard): Post-01.02.2019 land title transfer qualifies under PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines §§5.2–5.3.3(i) because ownership was transferred through inheritance resulting from demise of parent (transfer_basis = INHERITANCE_DUE_TO_DEATH; Death Cert DC/DK/2022/6104, Legal Heir Order LHC/DK/2022/339, and Bhoomi mutation Form 16 MR No. 2022-T771 verified); strictly distinct from post-cutoff sale, partition, or gift deeds which remain statutorily excluded under §5.3.3(ii); MIDH qualifies in Section A with installed drip irrigation; PM-KUSUM B qualifies in Section A for off-grid open well; SMAM and KCC Central qualify in Section A; PMFBY routed to Section B pending seasonal notification.

intended_test_purpose: MIDH coastal nursery / shade-net; Large holding (13.0 ac); Minority; post-2019 statutory inheritance upon demise of parent under PM-KISAN §§5.2–5.3.3(i) (transfer_basis=INHERITANCE_DUE_TO_DEATH, legal heir cert & mutation verified; distinct from ineligible partition, sale, and gift deeds under §5.3.3(ii)); PM-KISAN, MIDH, PM-KUSUM B, and SMAM qualify in Section A.
